hints: Group by department, and count a different condition in each column.
`SUM(CASE WHEN … THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)` counts the rows that match a condition.
Absent students fail every comparison, because NULL >= 85 is unknown. Give them their own `marks IS NULL` column.

statement:
A college publishes how many students in each department landed in each grade band:

| Band | Marks |
|---|---|
| A | 85 and above |
| B | 70 to 84 |
| C | 50 to 69 |
| F | below 50 |

Students who were absent have `marks` = NULL. Count them separately.

Return one row per department with the columns `dept`, `a_count`, `b_count`, `c_count`, `f_count` and `absent_count`, ordered by `dept`. A band with no students shows **0**.
title: Grade Bands by Department
